short: Shared test rig: throwaway PDS, stub PLC, Postgres harness, the PostgreSQL app setup
is: The shared test rig: a hermetic throwaway PDS with an in-process stub PLC directory, a one-container/template-clone Postgres harness, the app served on PostgreSQL behind an in-process sign-in (`pg_app`) with the den world seeded on it (`pg_app::den_world`), and the cross-adapter PublicRecords conformance suite.
conventions: Zero requests to the public atproto network — minting lands at the local stub only.
`DOCKER_HOST` is honored for the container socket; every rig needs a Tokio runtime (`#[tokio::test]`).
The default PDS image literal must equal `.env.example`'s `ZURFUR_PDS_IMAGE`.
Container reuse is an escape hatch, not the default.
entry_points: src/lib.rs (the usage recipe is in notes)

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: testcontainers + postgres module, axum for the PLC stub, adapter-pg for migrations, atrium-crypto, reqwest 0.13 + tower-sessions + http-cookies for http.rs, async-trait for the recording wrappers, base64 for pg_app's dev-profile root key, application for pg_app::den_world's Workflows (made through the create use case), reqwest multipart for its uploads, strum for pg_app::ProfileCacheState

fs.name: src/contract.rs
fs.role: the generic PublicRecords conformance suite (mem + atproto)

fs.name: src/cut.rs
fs.role: a client that goes away mid-request (send_raw) and DropWitness, the layer outside the stack that signals a request's future was dropped unfinished

fs.name: src/den.rs
fs.role: the den route suites' readers, shared by the in-memory and PostgreSQL setups: get, ok_json, cache_control, entry_names, PRIVATE_NO_STORE and Answer (status, every header but date, body bytes)

fs.name: src/fixture.rs
fs.role: FixtureAccount / ActingCredential (PDS session JWT)

fs.name: src/http.rs
fs.role: serve / serve_wrapped / client / client_with_origin / bare_client / sign_in — the api tests' HTTP fixture (binds 127.0.0.1:0, serves through http-stack's stack with the real session layer (http-cookies), router passed as a closure so test-support never depends on api; Served carries the Detach); client() sends Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin on every request, client_with_origin(base) sends Origin: base, bare_client sends no first-party signal; sign_in's POST /signin sends Origin: base, so any client signs in

fs.name: src/http/tests.rs
fs.role: pins the served rig running a cut request to its end through the detach layer, and each client's first-party signal (same-origin fetch metadata, its Origin, none) with a per-request header replacing the default, and sign_in's POST /signin sending Origin: base

fs.name: src/identity_resolver_contract.rs
fs.role: the generic IdentityResolver conformance suite over a runner-staged world (StagedIdentities); mem now, the atproto resolver next

fs.name: src/lib.rs
fs.role: crate docs + usage recipe; pins the ZURFUR_PDS_IMAGE literal

fs.name: src/log_capture.rs
fs.role: CapturedLog — a tracing-subscriber writer a driver's log test reads its own subscriber's output back from

fs.name: src/pds.rs
fs.role: ThrowawayPds::boot — container lifecycle, teardown on drop

fs.name: src/pg.rs
fs.role: shared Postgres harness: one container per process, migrated template, TEMPLATE clone per test; TestDb::psql_command, the command line that runs psql inside the container on one clone

fs.name: src/pg_app.rs
fs.role: the PostgreSQL test setup: pg_app::serve boots the app on composition's live PostgreSQL wiring over a fresh_db clone, sessions in PostgreSQL; PgServed::sign_in(Profile) drives the real sign-in routes, and sign_in_with_cookie also hands back the raw zurfur.sid value (SignedIn); pg_app::den_world seeds the den world on top

fs.name: src/pg_app/den_world.rs
fs.role: den_world(app) -> DenWorld, and den_world_recording(app, &StatementLog) through the statement proxy: alice, bob and a stranger signed in (profiles cached through GET /me); alice's Account "Supreme Arts" (Workflow "Queue") and bob's "Night Shift" ("Backlog"); "Untitled" and the archived "Old sketch", a file and a slot each, all through routes or use cases; bob a Participant of "Untitled" and set_visibility / store_unparsable_visibility as test-only writes; set_profile_cache(ProfileCacheState::{Warm, Cold}) fixes the profile cache's state for all three users; absent_* ids no seed writes

fs.name: src/pg_app/den_world/identity.rs
fs.role: identity's half of the den world's seeding, opt-in: add_bob_as_member (through the invitation routes), seed_closed_studio (alice's Account with bob a Member, deactivated by a test-only soft-delete call), seed_account_with_stored_name (a test-only name write); absent_account and stranger ids

fs.name: src/pg_app/in_process_pds.rs
fs.role: InProcessPds — the sign-in (Authenticator) and profile (ProfileSource) ports answered in-process for registered profiles; unknown handles/DIDs refused, and a callback without the browser binding its sign-in started with (BrowserMismatch)

fs.name: src/pg_app/pairs.rs
fs.role: the pairs of not-found causes on the den world, shared by the route, read and statement suites and the timing run: MissPair (absent, not_yours, home), stranger_targets (Untitled Private live; Old sketch Private, Public and Listed archived); the den routes' den_stranger_pairs (the commission, its changelog, its file), den_account_pair, den_character_pair (bob's user DID stands in: no Character on PostgreSQL yet) and den_participant_pairs (a file key, a slot, a Workflow); commission's commission_read_stranger_pairs, commission_read_live_pairs (with each pair's problem code), public_live_download_pair and download_participant_pair

fs.name: src/pg_app/served.rs
fs.role: serve + serve_recording (the app's database reached through the statement proxy) + PgServed (base_url, live Runtime, the PDS, psql_command onto its database) + SignedIn + the dev-profile Config (example root key, PLC submission off); sessions through http-cookies' session_layer over PgSessionStore; served through http-stack's stack (serve_wrapped adds outer layers, PgServed carries the Detach); PgServed::sign_in / sign_in_with_cookie hand back a client sending Origin: base_url on every request (DenWorld's too); pg_runtime: the same live wiring served nowhere, for use-case tests on PostgreSQL; serve_configured changes the dev Config before connecting (the log canary plants its root key)

fs.name: src/pg_app/statements.rs
fs.role: the statement proxy: record_statements(database_url, StatementLog) relays the app's PostgreSQL connections byte for byte and logs each executed statement (a simple query, or an Execute of a bound portal) with its bound values, read off the frontend protocol with TLS off; Statement displays as its adapter-pg query file (`commission/find`) or its SQL; parser unit tests in statements/tests.rs

fs.name: src/plc_stub.rs
fs.role: in-process stub PLC directory on loopback, reached via docker host-gateway

fs.name: src/recording.rs
fs.role: CallLog + recording wrappers over Database/UnitOfWork, DidMinter, FileStore, CommissionStore, ChangelogStore (entries) and WorkflowStore (its find logged as find_workflow) — tests read the order of begin/commit/rollback, external calls and store reads; SubjectLog + recording wrappers over the identity reads (AccountStore, UserStore, CharacterStore, ProfileCache, ProfileSource) — tests read which reads ran and whose data each asked for

fs.name: src/runtime.rs
fs.role: shared test runtime helper

fs.name: src/store_doubles.rs
fs.role: scripted wrappers over AccountStore and UserStore: real answers until a shared script makes a listing list a membership the store wouldn't, a read fail, or a user row read as gone; tests seed first, then script

fs.name: tests/throwaway_pds.rs
fs.role: self-test incl. the image/.env.example drift assertion

refs.title: My Den — Rulings from the First Slice's Design Study
refs.governs: src/pg_app/den_world.rs: the den world the PostgreSQL route suite reads, for the one not-found (D21) and archived commissions opening on a typed path (D13); src/pg_app/statements.rs and pairs.rs: D21 re-tested on PostgreSQL as the same SQL statements for both causes of each pair; store_legacy_title and store_legacy_filename store names from before the name rule, which read as Unnamed (D19) and stay the one not-found for a stranger (D21)

notes: src/pg.rs — lifecycle (moved from the module doc, 2026-09-12): Replaces the container-per-test pattern (a boot + full migration replay per test function) with a clone that costs tens of milliseconds, without weakening isolation: every test still gets its own pristine database.

The container is refcounted, not static. Each `TestDb` holds an `Arc` to the shared container; a `Weak` in a process-wide static lets later tests rejoin it. The last live handle reaps the container on drop (testcontainers has no ryuk-style reaper, so a never-dropped static would leak a running container past process exit). If the set of live tests briefly drains to zero mid-run, the next test simply boots a fresh container — correct, just slower for that one boot.
See also: ZMVP-103 — throwaway-PDS rig scope (src/lib.rs: crate purpose/scope).

See also: ZMVP-105 — PublicRecords conformance seam / open auth fork, Jacquard OAuth vs PDS local credentials (src/fixture.rs `ActingCredential`; src/contract.rs; tests/throwaway_pds.rs `bearer`, `boot_act_destroy`).
See also: ZMVP-134 — shared-container Postgres harness (src/pg.rs).
See also: ZMVP-102 — `.env.example`'s `ZURFUR_PDS_IMAGE` ownership; `test-support::DEFAULT_PDS_IMAGE` must match it (src/lib.rs `DEFAULT_PDS_IMAGE`, `default_image_matches_env_example`).
See also: ZMVP-106 — determinism capstone that reuses `contract::fixed_created_at()` (src/contract.rs).
See also: ZMVP-199 ruling 8 / Engineer ruling 2026-08-25 — one shared `MemRuntime` fixture instead of a copy per test file (src/runtime.rs).
See also: uow 28ca4f — origin of the `default_image_matches_env_example` drift guard (src/lib.rs).

src/pg_app.rs — the PostgreSQL test setup. Only the sign-in and profile ports are swapped (both onto `InProcessPds`); every other port is composition's live wiring, so the DID minter is the real one with the example root key and PLC submission off (minting stays in PostgreSQL). The setup touches the app only through the sign-in routes, so a change to the sign-in seam is fixed here alone. A test that needs another port changed (a recording or silent profile source) swaps it inside the `app` closure, which receives the Runtime.
